query:
SELECT 1 AS "found!: i64" FROM feed_sources fs
                         JOIN entries e ON e.id = fs.collection_id
                         WHERE (fs.feed_url = ? OR fs.collection_id = ?)
                           AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', e.created_at) > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', ?)
                         LIMIT 1
